columns.name: SC_DETAILS_ID
columns.description: This field uses SDTE_SCHEDULE_DETAIL_S sequence to generate the auto-increment field for each schedule details of an extraction request.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_NAME
columns.description: Schedule Name. Used alike while creating ESS schedule.

columns.name: EXTRACT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the extraction details table.

columns.name: ACTIVE
columns.description: Flag whether the schedule is Active or not.

columns.name: FREQUENCY
columns.description: Frequency of occurance of the schedule

columns.name: FREQUENCY_MINUTE_INTERVAL
columns.description: In case the schedule is in Minutes, the value of the interval.

columns.name: FREQUENCY_HOURLY_INTERVAL
columns.description: In case the schedule is in Hour, the value of the interval.

columns.name: FREQUENCY_DAILY_INTERVAL
columns.description: In case the schedule is in Daily, the value of the interval.

columns.name: FREQUENCY_WEEKLY_INTERVAL
columns.description: In case the schedule is in weeks, the value of interval.

columns.name: FREQUENCY_MONTHLY_INTERVAL
columns.description: In case the schedule is in Months, the value of interval.

columns.name: FREQUENCY_YEARLY_INTERVAL
columns.description: In case the schedule is in Years, the value of interval.

columns.name: TIMEZONE
columns.description: Time zone to create the schedule

columns.name: STARTTIME
columns.description: Start time of the schedule.
